many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

def solve(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    for i in range(h):
        if len(set(inp[i]))>1: return ('row',i)
    for j in range(w):
        if len({inp[i][j] for i in range(h)})>1: return ('col',j)

def analyze(name):
    inp=G[name+' input']; out=G[name+' output']
    kind,pos=solve(inp); h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0]); seq=list(inp[pos]) if kind=='row' else [inp[i][pos] for i in range(h)]
    K=len(seq)
    kept=set()
    # neighbors outward from seq line; a neighbor is kept if output there equals input, extend while uniform
    if kind=='row':
        off=-1
        rr=pos+off
        while 0<=rr<h and all(out[rr][c]==inp[rr][c] for c in range(w)): kept.add(rr); rr+=off
        off=1
        rr=pos+off
        while 0<=rr<h and all(out[rr][c]==inp[rr][c] for c in range(w)): kept.add(rr); rr+=off
    else:
        off=-1
        cc=pos+off
        while 0<=cc<w and all(out[r][cc]==inp[r][cc] for r in range(h)): kept.add(cc); cc+=off
        off=1
        cc=pos+off
        while 0<=cc<w and all(out[r][cc]==inp[r][cc] for r in range(h)): kept.add(cc); cc+=off
    body=[k for k in range(h) if kind=='row' and k!=pos and k not in kept] \
          if kind=='row' else [c for c in range(w) if c!=pos and c not in kept]
    assert all(len({out[b]})==1 for b in body), name
    idxmap={}
    for b in body:
        v=out[b][0]
        q=[q for q in range(K) if seq[q]==v][0]
        idxmap[b]=q
    print(name,'kind',kind,'pos',pos,'K',K,'seq at edge?',pos in (0,h-1)','kept',sorted(kept))
    print('  idx by position:', sorted(idxmap.items()))
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    analyze(n)

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find multicolor line
    cand=[]
    for i in range(h):
        s_=set(g[i]); if len(s_)>1: cand.append(('row',i))
    for j in range(w):
        sc={g[r][j] for r in range(h)}; if len(sc)>1: cand.append(('col',j))
    kind,P=cand[0]
    # neighbor line color
    Q=P+1 if kind=='row' else P+1
    ncol=None
    while 0<=Q<h:
        if kind=='row': ncol=set(g[Q]); break
        Q+=1
    ncol=ncol.pop() if ncol else None
    K=len(set(x for line in g for x in line if True)) # will fix below
    vals=[g[P][j] for j in range(w)] if kind=='row' else [g[r][P] for r in range(h)]
    K=len(vals)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    def idx(d): return d-2   # dist-2 in cycle, skipping kept neighbor
    if kind=='row':
        for r in range(h):
            if r==P: continue
            d=abs(r-P)
            if d==1: continue   # kept neighbor
            v=vals[idx(d%K)]
            out[r]=[v]*w
    else:
        for c in range(w):
            if c==P: continue
            d=abs(c-P)
            if d==1: continue
            v=vals[idx(d%K)]
            for r in range(h): out[r][c]=v
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    ok = solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output']
    print(k, ok)
